name: Ymir
subtitle: Worldbringer
description: Cast avalanches and bring down the mountain on your foes with Freeze and Speed Debuffs.
lore: Ancestor of the jotnar, Ymir is a primal being who predates the gods and even the realm of Asgard. It is said the first gods crafted the world from Ymir’s flesh. He has largely slumbered since, and the Ymir encountered in Ryven represents only a sliver of this primordial power’s body and mind. His full awakening at the hands of the Primal Powers could end Asgard.
divinity_generator: Gain [50] Divinity when this hero places [Freeze].

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Ignore RES +20%, Barrier Multiplier +30%, DMG Multiplier +30%
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%

skills.name: Avalanche
skills.description: Attack all enemies (10%HP+120%ATK)+(10%HP+120%ATK). Reduces each target’s SPD by 10 (Stacking up to 3 times).
skills.awakening_bonus: At max stacks, will place [Freeze] on each target for 1 turn which cannot be blocked or resisted.

skills.name: Mountainfall
skills.description: Attack all enemies (7%HP+100%ATK) with a 80% chance to place [mechanic:spd-down-ii] on each target for 2 turns. Then attack all enemies (7%HP+100%ATK) with a 80% to place [mechanic:freeze] on enemies under [mechanic:spd-down-ii] for 1 turn.
skills.awakening_bonus: Each time this hero places [Freeze], reduce this hero's Divinity Cost by 10 (stacking up to 30 times) and increase the damage this hero inflicts on their next Ultimate Ability by 3%.

skills.name: Chilling Breach
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (11%HP+130%ATK) with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:def-down-ii] for 2 turns. If the target is under [mechanic:freeze], place [mechanic:barrier] on this hero equal to 5% of the damage inflicted.

skills.name: Frozen Blood
skills.description: When this hero is attacked, has a 50% chance to place[mechanic:freeze] the enemy for 1 turn.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also has a 50% chance to place [Freeze] if any [Disable] or [Debuff]

imprint_passive: When this hero is attacked, has a 25% chance to place [Freeze] the enemy for 1 turn.
